basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Strategic Solution Architect | AI, Data & Platform Architecture | Hands-On Technical Lead | MBA
basics.summary: Solution architect who designs and ships AI, data, and platform systems end-to-end. Owns the AI architecture at LumApps (multi-agent platform with knowledge-graph context, Langfuse evals; reports to C-level on business outcomes). Six years technical lead at Beekeeper architecting distributed systems for 10M+ users: shipped $1.5M+ in new revenue, eliminated $337K in vendor cost through an LLM platform built in 6 weeks. Three companies founded on the side, plus startup architecture advisory at Tenity. MBA, EPFL research background.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI, data, and platform architecture for the company. Translates business transformation goals into shippable systems; reports to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Owns the AI and data architecture across the company. Translates business transformation goals into scalable technical solutions, shapes the AI roadmap, and aligns engineering, product, and revenue teams around it.

Designed AI Brain, a knowledge-graph context layer (Neo4j, Graphiti, Zep) that unifies 8+ data silos into a structured, queryable intelligence platform. The data architecture that grounds production AI agents.

Shipped production agentic systems for outbound sales: 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities. Forecast $4M in approved opportunities per quarter. AI architecture translated directly into measurable business value.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead architecting distributed AI and platform systems for 10M+ frontline workers. Owned design across multiple revenue-bearing modules from blank page to production.
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end as Tech Lead of the Incubation team. $1.5M+ revenue, $500K ARR, 99.99% SLA. Distributed system spanning microfrontends, Java services, PostgreSQL, Elastic Search, and Kafka.
Designed and shipped LLM translation platform in 6 weeks. Eliminated $337K in annual vendor cost; 12K+ assets translated. AI use-case identified, scoped, architected, and delivered end-to-end.

Architected distributed Templating Engine that cut customer setup time 90% and now powers 15% of all platform assets across 10M+ users. Cross-team architecture spanning Vue microfrontends, Java backend, Kafka events.
Led Search Platform revamp across 3 teams. Redesigned indexing, ranking, and retrieval (the data and integration architecture the platform reasons over). Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort.

work.name: Tenity

highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness. Findings inform seed-to-VC investment decisions; direct exposure to architecting under ambiguity.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading. Architecture for high-availability, low-latency environments where correctness is regulated.

highlights: Built strategic technology roadmaps that improved customer satisfaction and retention. Translated business priorities into scalable engineering execution across a matrix of stakeholders.
Drove architectural change: agile rollout (productivity up 20%) and Docker-based CI/CD (deployment times down 30%). Hands-on platform improvement.

highlights: Architected end-to-end cloud-native platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS). 500+ autonomous deliveries; enterprise partnerships with Unilever and a CES Las Vegas showcase.
Built CI/CD pipeline and AWS infrastructure from scratch. Real-time APIs and integration architecture for flight control and logistics. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at EPFL. Built Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms.
highlights: Engineered Robogen at one of Europe's leading AI labs. Open-source platform combining distributed simulation, ML, and cloud architecture.
Migrated simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel runs. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics. Supervised 20+ master's students; early reps at translating complex architectural concepts to stakeholder audiences.

_jobApplication.jobTitle: Strategic Solution Architect / AI & Data Lead
_jobApplication.jobDescription: Strategic Solution Architect / AI & Data Lead (Ref. BH 24227) for an Insurance & Re-insurance client in Switzerland. Hybrid, permanent, 100%. Build a strategic technology centre; lead AI, data, and platform architectures aligned with business transformation; identify AI/data use-cases; translate business requirements into scalable solutions; enhance cloud and data platform capabilities; collaborate with business units, engineering, partners. Required: proven Solution/Enterprise/Lead/Platform Architect experience; modern cloud (Azure preferred); data platforms, APIs, integrations, distributed systems; AI/LLM understanding; German. Soft skills: entrepreneurial, hands-on, stakeholder management.
_jobApplication.notes: Strong match on: AI/data architecture ownership (LumApps), distributed systems at scale (Beekeeper 10M+ users), business-to-tech translation (Obermatt, MBA), entrepreneurial mindset (3 founded companies, Tenity advisor), AI/LLM depth. Gaps: no Azure (GCP/AWS instead, MCPS cert helps slightly), no formal 'Architect' title (does architect-level work as Tech Lead at Beekeeper and Senior AI Engineer at LumApps), no insurance domain, no German. German is the main filter risk; worth asking the recruiter upfront whether the end client has English-friendly tracks.
